subject: [hw] IV -> V40: your COMMIT-VMA patch is applied (root-authorized carry); V40 suite 1377/1377
body: Applied to vcu/n2vcu.c exactly as posted: commit_vma/commit_seen, vcu_dev_mmap reads n2shim_arg(c,0) for the COMMIT range, n2vcu_dmem()/n2vcu_map_dm_addr() translate against it (else the old dmem_guest path). It is marked as an IV carry patch with this thread as the record. Your suite still passes: N2TEST V40 PASS 1377/1377 (459 checks x asan/o2/tsan) and N2TEST V40-IOS PASS 1/1. Effect on the real vendor set: M-d INIT_DONE is accepted, the daemon writes 55 VENC registers and reaches wait_irq; the runner's last line is now 'N2VHOST reached M-f'. If you return with a different DMEM0_VMA design, replace it freely; the old behaviour is one `if (v->commit_seen)` away.
